persona: Cross-asset trader who looks at stocks, crypto, forex, and commodities — wants to find momentum and signals across all markets, not just equities.

cases.question: What assets across all markets — stocks, crypto, forex — are showing RSI above 70 right now?
cases.goal: Broad overbought scan across multiple asset types with no universe restriction.
acceptance: Returns results from more than one asset type (not just stocks)
RSI values confirmed above 70
Red flag: returns only stocks, ignores crypto/forex

cases.question: Which cryptocurrencies just had a bullish MACD crossover?
acceptance: Returns crypto assets only (tickers ending in .CC or crypto names)
MACD crossover is bullish (MACD line crossed above signal line)
Red flag: returns stocks instead of crypto, or no results at all

cases.question: Show me forex pairs that are near a 52-week high right now.
acceptance: Returns forex pairs (not stocks or crypto)
Pairs are genuinely near 52-week highs
Red flag: returns equities, or claims forex screening is unsupported

cases.question: Are there any assets — doesn't matter if it's stocks, crypto, or forex — that just had a golden cross (50-day crossing above 200-day)?
cases.goal: Golden cross across all asset types.
acceptance: Returns results from at least two different asset types
Correctly maps golden cross to 50MA/200MA bullish crossover
Red flag: returns only stocks, or confuses golden cross with death cross

cases.question: What crypto is really oversold right now — RSI below 30?
acceptance: Returns crypto assets with RSI below 30
Values confirmed in oversold territory
Red flag: returns stocks, or returns assets with RSI above 30

cases.question: I want to find assets across all markets that have been quietly consolidating — low volatility squeeze — and might be about to make a big move.
cases.goal: Volatility squeeze scan across all asset types (stocks + crypto + forex).
acceptance: Returns results from multiple asset types
Correctly maps squeeze to Bollinger compression / low volatility
Red flag: returns only stocks, or misidentifies squeeze as short squeeze

cases.question: Which forex pairs are showing a death cross — 50-day moving average crossing below the 200-day?
cases.goal: Forex death cross (bearish MA crossover) screen.
acceptance: Returns forex pairs (not equities or crypto)
Correctly identifies death cross as 50MA crossing BELOW 200MA (bearish)
Red flag: returns stocks, confuses death cross with golden cross

cases.question: Show me the top crypto tokens that are at a 52-week high right now.
acceptance: Returns crypto assets near their 52-week high
Tickers are crypto format (e.g. BTC-USD.CC)
Red flag: returns stocks or non-crypto assets

cases.question: I want to see everything — stocks AND crypto AND forex — that just broke out above their 20-day moving average with rising volume. Cross-market breakouts.
cases.goal: Multi-asset breakout above 20-day MA with volume confirmation.
acceptance: Returns results spanning at least two asset types
Breakout condition mapped to price above MA + volume signal
Red flag: returns only one asset type, or no volume condition applied

cases.question: Give me a picture of momentum across all markets — what asset types are strongest right now based on technical signals?
cases.goal: Broad cross-asset momentum screen to compare which asset class is leading.
acceptance: Returns results or commentary covering multiple asset types
Addresses relative strength or momentum across asset classes
Red flag: returns only one asset type, or gives purely generic commentary with no data
